sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface biotinylation detected rSK2-Myc in the membrane fraction of Cosm6 cells, confirming surface display of the tagged channel; function of the tagged channel was NOT MEASURED.
sites.rationale: L1 reports a triple Myc tag tolerated extracellularly between S3 and S4 in rSK2 (KCNN2), a close paralog of KCNN1 (SK1); L3 confirms surface display by biotinylation. The orthologous loop in KCNN1 spans residues 202-225 (24 residues), providing ample space for a 15-23 aa insert and lying well clear of both TM3 (ends at 201) and TM4 (starts at 226). No specific junction residue is named in the ledger, so this is a region-level site. Ranked first because the loop is long, the tag (3xMyc) is demanding, and surface display is biochemically confirmed. rSK2 (KCNN2) was engineered with a triple Myc tag extracellularly between the S3 and S4 domains; surface biotinylation of Cosm6 cells confirmed the tagged full-length channel is membrane-displayed (L1, L3). KCNN1 carries the orthologous extracellular S3-S4 loop at residues 202-225 (24 residues), which is the corresponding region in SK1.

literature_notes: KCNN1 (SK1) has three extracellular loops per the authoritative topology: EC1 (S1-S2, residues 131-136, 6 aa), EC2 (S3-S4, residues 202-225, 24 aa), and EC3 (S5-pore-S6, residues 302-344, 43 aa). No ledger line reports any tag insertion in EC3 (the pore-turret region), so no site is proposed there despite its length. L2 reports an HA tag in rSK1 (KCNN1 itself) placed intracellularly between S2 and S3 (IC2, residues 161-185); this is a direct finding for KCNN1 but the tag faces the cytoplasm and is recorded in other_positions only. L3 confirms surface display of both the rSK2-Myc (extracellular tag) and rSK1-HA (intracellular tag) constructs, but the rSK1-HA tag is not extracellular. No ledger line names a specific residue junction for any extracellular site in KCNN1 or its paralogs, so both surface sites are region-level (insert_after_residue=null). The EC1 site is flagged low confidence because the 6-residue loop is very short for a 15-23 aa insert.

literature_other_positions.note: rSK1 (KCNN1) was engineered with an HA tag intracellularly between the S2 and S3 domains (IC2 loop, residues 161-185); the tag faces the cytoplasm and is not accessible on the extracellular surface.
